sources.entry: RosarioSIS - Student Information System for school management. Features students demographics, grades, scheduling, attendance, student billing, discipline & food service modules. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.name: RosarioSIS
summary.one_liner: RosarioSIS is a free and open source Student Information System (school management system) for grades, scheduling, attendance, billing and more, built as a PHP web application.
use_cases: run a student and parent portal
summary.what_it_does: RosarioSIS bundles student records, grades, scheduling, attendance, student billing, discipline and food service modules into one web application. It is primarily designed for K-12 schools but the page says it can be adapted to universities and institutes. It includes a student and parent portal, online user and student registration, statistical charts, and PDF document generation. It is written in PHP and runs on a PostgreSQL or MySQL database, accessed through a browser. The interface is responsive and translated into several languages, and it offers Moodle LMS integration.
notable: Translated into about a dozen languages including French, Spanish, German and Russian
Student and parent portal with online registration
Numerous free and Premium add-ons available
caveats: Numerous add-ons are Premium, so some features may be paid
